editor_note: On the Wausau Friday Fish Fry Guide with matching address/phone. Friday fry described as shrimp and perch. Neighborhood bar with banquet hall, pool, darts, patio. Listed hours are bar hours - confirm the fry window.

HOLD - monthly, not weekly. OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark). MONTHLY, NOT WEEKLY - the post's own page is titled 'Monthly Fish Fry', calendar shows single Fridays. Currently 'Closed for the summer, Fish Fry will resume this fall' so roughly fall through spring. Deep fried or baked fish and/or shrimp, baked potato or fries, salad bar. The Loyal chamber's 'Every Friday Night' claim conflicts with the post's own site and appears stale. Far outside the footprint.

HOLD - 50 minutes from Wausau. OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark). STRONGEST CONFIRMED HALL FRY ANYWHERE IN THE SWEEP and the only weekly year-round one. Baked or deep-fried cod, shrimp, chicken strips, steak, burgers; fries or potato salad, rye bread, salad bar. Facebook posts in Feb AND Sept confirm not Lent-only. Public dining per the city directory and Clark County Tourism; Tavern League member. Verified active on Google Maps (4.7, 96 reviews). Own website publishes the full fish fry. Serving since 1926. Haddock baked or fried 2pc $9.50 / 3pc $11.50, 7pc shrimp $13.50, walleye $18. Coleslaw, bread, fries or potato salad. Dine-in or takeout. Attached ballroom - good sponsor story.

Home-style cafe. Tue-Sat 6:30AM-2PM but Friday extends to 7PM - the Friday-only evening hours corroborate the fry. Reviews cite crispy fish, homemade bread, coleslaw, tartar. No phone from a reliable source.

OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Lincoln). Haddock fry with fries, twice-baked potato or wedges, coleslaw and dinner roll, from their own site. Downtown Merrill with real web presence - likely paid-tier prospect. Already in WPR's Lenten guide.

HOLD - county unverified (Lake DuBay tri-county corner). COUNTY CHECK NEEDED. On Lake DuBay with boat docking; Friday fish fry cited. Some directories place it in Portage or Wood County - Lake DuBay is at the three-county corner. Confirm Marathon County before listing.

NEEDS HOURS before activating. Also 'The B&R'. Near-north-side corner bar and grill. Known for the EURO pizza, fresh-cut fries and Krueger's Bakery buns - good description material. Get the fry window and species.

OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark (entirely)). Panko-breaded cod with twice-baked potato and seafood bisque; fish Fridays, prime rib Saturdays. One aggregator calls it among the best Friday frys in the Wausau area. Listed hours are bar hours.

Stratford mailing address but physically in Rozellville (Town of Day). Building dates to the 1800s as a blacksmith/buggy shop - the fireplace was the forge, horses tied at what is now the back bar. Reservations advised Fridays. Great story for a featured slot.

PHONE BLANK - every number found was shared with the Legion post or pro shop.

Countryside tavern in the Town of Green Valley (south Marathon County), Mosinee mailing address. Cod, walleye, perch, jumbo gulf shrimp Fridays. Also known for broasted chicken. Closed Mon-Tue.

West-side tavern with outdoor volleyball, pool, darts, karaoke. Friday fry described as cod and perch baskets. Directory source only - confirm species, price, window. Not on any Lenten guide, a genuine gap.
